column1: # "You're not alone": battle lines for the "???" fight (battle/party_join.c).

column3: You stand well alone.\nLet me see what's left\nwhen that breaks.
There. No one is\ncoming, Isaac.{page_break}This is all you are\nwithout them.
Isaac!{page_break}I won't watch you\nfall. Not while I can\nstill reach you!
You held our bodies.\nNot our hearts.{page_break}He was never alone.\nNot for one moment.

You stubborn idiot!
Did you think I'd just
stand there and watch?{page_break}We left Vale together.
We finish this
together!

I felt you holding on,
Isaac. It broke
her hold on me.{page_break}We're all here now.
You're not alone!
So this is what\nyou are, Isaac.{page_break}Not one.\nFour.
